BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ethics for legislative employees; and adding anew section to chapter 42.52 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An employee of the legislature is exempt from this chapter for anact that is a violation of this chapter if the employee was directed bya member of the legislature, in writing, to perform the act.
